title: PAR-134 LIGHT CMC flags and reserved-index retention
mode: generated AC1024 DWG object-vector fast slice
scope: Retain R2004+ LIGHT CMC source flags and reserved index
Preserve flagged-empty optional CMC strings through DWG rewrite
Refuse invalid or unsupported source metadata before output
Leave LIGHT-specific DXF color mapping and producer semantics unqualified

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: R2004+ CMC has a leading BS color index that is always zero, a packed BL method/value, and an RC byte whose low bits indicate optional color-name and book-name TV values. This slice preserves that generic CMC state at the existing LIGHT color field path; it does not establish class-specific LIGHT semantics.

localSource.finding: The LIGHT parser retained method/scalar/RGB and optional strings but omitted raw flags/index. The writer reconstructed flags from nonempty strings, which discarded an explicitly flagged empty name.

productionSummary: Append LIGHT CMC flags, reserved index, and metadata-presence fields; reset clears them.
Capture source flags/index in the bounded parser and replay supported source flags, including flagged-empty strings.
Reject nonzero index, unknown flag bits, strings without their flags, unsupported methods, and absent detached streams before output.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: Appended CMC provenance fields increase DRW_Light object size; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.dwgVectors: Generated AC1024 frames cover C0-C3, black RGB, nonempty names/books, flagged-empty color name, and a C3-to-C5 parser mutation.
generatedControls.wireWalk: Independent cursor asserts CMC method/value, raw flags/index, and following LIGHT fields/handle alignment.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Copy construction, assignment, reset, and raw metadata presence are asserted.
generatedControls.failClosed: Invalid scalar/RGB state, unsupported C5 output, nonzero reserved index, unknown flags, inconsistent string flags, and flagged-empty names without detached string storage are refused before output.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_wave1_tests libdxfrw_hardening_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4

evidenceLimits: Generated local frame/wire tests establish local implementation consistency, not independent producer semantics for LIGHT CMC fields.
No persistent fixture, external reader, native CAD application, full suite, or platform qualification was run.
No LIGHT-specific DXF color/name/book mapping is asserted or added.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
